Installation

Install satlight from PyPI:

pip install satlight

This pulls in the required dependencies automatically: numpy, matplotlib, astropy, skyfield, sgp4, trimesh, tqdm, plotly, xarray, and bpy (Blender’s Python API, used for ray tracing).

Note

bpy is a large package. If you only need to build the docs (not run renders), you don’t need it installed in your docs build environment.

Data files

Some larger data files are not bundled with the pip package:

  • The BRDF material reflectance database (satlight/data/BRDFDatabase/)

  • Example 3D satellite models (satlight/data/models/)

Contact the maintainer for access, and place them under satlight/data/ after installing the package.

Development install

To work on satlight itself:

git clone https://github.com/lfbeesley/satlight.git
cd satlight
pip install -e .
